annotation_type.automatic: No canonical human annotation; V3 silver target

empty_values: CSV empty fields mean no authoritative human annotation or unavailable upstream provenance; never zero by default.

decoding.rule: if p_ge_1 < t1: low; elif p_ge_2 < t2: medium; else: high

rubric_note: Historical human rubric aggregate scores span 0-5; the release sensitivity scores are class indices 0-2 and must not be confused with rubric totals.

columns.image_id: Stable SHA-256 identity of the image bytes; identical to sha256.
columns.image_path: Portable path relative to the release root; resolves to the single copied image.
columns.source_dataset: Canonical source identifier, retained from upstream curation.
columns.source_original_path: First lexicographically sorted original curator-relative source path; provenance only, not a release file.
columns.source_original_paths_json: All original curator-relative paths, including both references for the known RRDataset duplicate.
columns.sha256: SHA-256 of the unchanged image bytes.
columns.source_dataset_license: Original dataset license; does not replace image-level upstream rights.
columns.source_original_id: Original upstream sample ID where recorded; empty when unavailable. RR filenames are not asserted to be upstream IDs.
columns.source_resolved_revision: Immutable upstream revision where recorded; OpenFake pilot and RRDataset lack this record.
columns.real_fake_label: Source authenticity: 0 real, 1 fake; never inferred by the sensitivity model.
columns.real_fake_label_name: Text form of original binary authenticity.
columns.real_fake_label_provenance: Evidence recorded by source curation; RR uses normalized local ai/real directory metadata, not an independently preserved upstream file index.
columns.annotation_type: human or automatic; mutually exclusive release subset membership.
columns.sensitivity_label_quality: human for authoritative human annotations, silver for automatic-only predictions; not a calibrated confidence score.
columns.human_annotation_available: true if canonical final human supervision exists; false otherwise.
columns.human_annotation_source: human_master_final or consolidated_human_review; empty for automatic-only rows.
columns.human_sensitivity_score: Final human class encoded 0/1/2; empty for automatic-only rows.
columns.human_sensitivity_label: Authoritative human low/medium/high; empty for automatic-only rows.
columns.predicted_sensitivity_score: Saved V3 sensitivity prediction 0/1/2, retained for every image, including human rows.
columns.predicted_sensitivity_label: Saved V3 text prediction, retained independently of human ground truth.
columns.p_ge_1: Monotonic corrected cumulative probability P(score >= 1); not a real/fake probability.
columns.p_ge_2: Monotonic corrected cumulative probability P(score >= 2); clipped to min(raw p_ge_1, raw p_ge_2).
columns.final_sensitivity_score: Human score where available, otherwise saved V3 score.
columns.final_sensitivity_label: Human label where available, otherwise saved V3 label.
columns.model_version: Sensitivity annotator identifier; does not imply that human final targets were model-generated.
columns.checkpoint_sha256: SHA-256 of the V3 checkpoint responsible for saved automatic predictions.
columns.v3_supervision_split: Existing V3 role: training, validation, frozen_test or not_used. Subset membership is not a new learning split.
